items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: But you know when people say who were your influences, everything you hear is your influence you know? I mean there were so many singers, how can you nail it down to one or two people? As I went along I loved Ella, I loved Billie Holiday of course, who else, Peggy Lee I mentioned.

ctx.x: And they’d let me sit in. I guess they thought I wasn’t too bad or they wouldn’t have asked me to come in. They’d always want me to come up. I’d sing “The Man I Love” and

I don’t know what all, the funny songs you know, can’t remember even the rest. That was before I sang “Happiness is a Thing Called Joe” after I heard Frances Wayne sing it. But you know when people say who were your influences, everything you hear is your influence you know? I mean there were so many singers, how can you nail it down to one or two people? As I went along I loved Ella, I loved Billie Holiday of course, who else, Peggy Lee I mentioned.
And your good buddy Sarah Vaughan.
